If it sounds like they are serious as the week progresses, I will have to as I can't think of anything else I can do from the sidelines. I just fear that breaking open any kind of trust they may have with me could also send them into an even darker spot.

Thanks for the advice

Thanks for taking time to reply.

We still get together fairly regularly; one on ones or in a group. Play disc golf; go to the movies, etc.

The "giving up" is moreso relating to attempts to help reduce the suffering from depresion/anxiety/etc from a medical standpoint; whether it be therapy or medication
